rents.range_basis: 10th-90th percentile over 84 tracts of ACS 2020-2024 rent of units built 2010-2019 over all rented units
rents.evidence: python -m jobs.check_rents_acs: ACS 2020-2024 B25111 (median gross rent of units built 2010-2019) over B25064 (all rented units), median over 84 tracts with lots in Atlanta. Units built 2020 or later: 1.051 over 20 tracts.
rents.caveat: Census rents include long-tenure leases and utilities; no public rent rolls outside Chicago. Replace with a rent source when one is available.

property_tax.basis: 40.909 mills on taxable value x 0.40 (Georgia assesses 40% of fair market value)
property_tax.rate_note: Fulton County 2025 millage inside the City of Atlanta: city with Atlanta Public Schools 31.870, Fulton County 9.039. Georgia taxes 40% of fair market value. DeKalb part of the city differs. 2026 city and school rates not yet found.
property_tax.caveat: Non-homestead rate for an in-city lot; special districts some lots pay are not included.

impact_fees.basis: City of Atlanta development impact fees at full rate (phase 3, from September 1, 2023): transportation, parks, fire and police. Duplexes to fourplexes pay multifamily rates. Water and sewer charges are not included.

components.name: Atlanta transportation impact fee
components.note: Single family by gross floor area: under 1,500 sq ft, 1,500 to 2,499, 2,500 or more. Multifamily low-rise (1-2 stories); mid-rise $1,376. Half off within 1,000 walking feet of a MARTA station when parking stays at or below the minimum.
